answer: Run a farm like a crew on a long voyage where one mutineer sinks the ship. Anyone who publishes a message signed by two different keys proves common control and claims half of both keys' locked rewards; the rest burns and the seats merge into one. A 30-key farm must keep 30 secrets on servers, scripts and hired hands, and each of its 435 key pairs is a beacon paying ~8,000 POA, so one leaked laptop or bitter contractor ends it. To block staged claims, the reporter key must be 20 epochs old and a copper-cheap 50 POA fee is lost on a bad signature.
